facts.value: Arizona State University accepts financial aid for online programs. Financial aid is money that can help you cover tuition, books, course fees and other school-related expenses.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: In order to receive most forms of financial aid, you must submit the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA).
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: Many tuition benefit options exist for veterans, active military members, spouses and dependents.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: The ASU and Uber Education Partnership will cover 100% of your remaining tuition and fees toward a bachelor’s degree after any free aid, such as federal or state grants.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: If you’ve taken college courses before, you may be able to transfer credits into your ASU degree program.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: ASU offers nearly $700 million in financial aid each year.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: The Free Application for Federal Student Aid is an application that allows U.S. citizens and eligible non-citizens to apply for federal aid, including need-based aid such as grants and loans.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: If you don’t file your FAFSA, you won’t be eligible for federal grants and loans, which may cover a large portion, if not all, of your tuition expenses.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: Your FAFSA also determines your eligibility for state grants and need-based scholarships, which can further reduce your educational costs.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: There is no fee to fill out the FAFSA, and doing so qualifies you to receive free money or affordable loans.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: The FAFSA is shorter and simpler than ever, so dedicating just a small amount of time can lead to large financial benefits.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: The FAFSA will open the October before your academic year begins, and close on the last day of the academic year.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership

facts.value: You must submit a new FAFSA every year to keep receiving financial aid.
facts.programme_association: Master’s in International Affairs and Leadership
